Definition: probably of foreign origin; Assus, a city of Asia MInor:--Assos.
BiblicalUsage: Assos was the port where Paul's companions went ahead by ship while he walked the land road to meet them there. Luke names it twice in the same journey, once as the place they sailed to and once as the place where they took Paul aboard.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the detail matters because Luke was there, keeping the journey honest mile by mile, and a seaport most readers would never see still stands in the record.
